answer: Bind each identity to one licensed amateur-radio callsign from the public registry: a callsign is earned only by passing an exam, so one operator holds one call. A sybil farm looks like a nebula of fake names, but each fake needs its own exam-passed callsign, and a grove of a thousand fakes needs a thousand exams. The registry is the signal that separates real operators from clones. Limit: exams are slow, some countries have no licensing, and callsigns can be rented, so it should gate high-value actions only.
